en: The most common Seaborn specimen. They drift across the seabed in swarms like white bones pushed by the tide; any warm object that approaches draws their bite.
_zh: 最常见的海嗣个体。它们成群地漂过海床，像被潮水推着的白骨，任何靠近的温热之物都会引来它们的撕咬。

en: A Seaborn that slides along the seabed, moving much faster than it appears. Anyone it rams into will find the lamp in their hands suddenly dimming.
_zh: 贴着海床滑行的海嗣，动作比看上去快得多。被它撞上的人，手里的灯会猛地一暗。

en: A Seaborn carrying a rock shell. It tends to half-bury itself in the seabed, then hurl chiseled rubble at intruders.
_zh: 背着岩壳的海嗣，习惯把自己半埋进海床，再把凿下的碎石抛向来者。

en: Izumik's Offspring. Slow, bloated, and possessing astonishing vitality. Upon touching prey, it molts into another Seaborn.
_zh: 伊祖米克的子代。缓慢、臃肿，生命力惊人，碰到猎物后会蜕变成别的海嗣。

en: Bait spawned by the Retching Broodmother. They do not move, only slowly wither, spewing corrosive acid before their demise.
_zh: 投嗣育母产下的诱饵。它们不会移动，只会缓缓衰亡，并在衰亡前喷出腐蚀性的酸液。

en: Its spit in the sea has an extremely high initial velocity, enough to shatter reefs. Where the acid lands, a patch of Nethersea Brand is left behind.
_zh: 在海中喷吐的初速极快，足以击碎礁石。酸液落下的地方，留下一片溟痕。
_note: 校对：“spits”作为名词复数不符合语法，应改为单数“spit”并调整谓语动词。

en: Fragments peeled off when a Pathshaper is severely wounded, testing impassable paths for their mother.
_zh: 塑路者受到重创时剥落的碎片，替母体去试那些走不通的路。

en: A teardrop shed by Ishar'mla. It remains in place, accumulating the power she needs for her transformation.
_zh: 伊莎玛拉渗出的泪滴，停在原地，替她积蓄转化所需的力量。

en: A crawler carrying an air sac. Inside is highly pressurized corrosive liquid; its death is a violent burst.
_zh: 背负着气囊的爬行者。囊内是高压的腐蚀性液体，它的死亡就是一次爆裂。

en: A low-altitude Levitating Seaborn. It evades attacks with erratic movements and projects barrages inflicting Corrosion from afar.
_zh: 低空悬浮的海嗣，用飘忽的移动躲避攻击，并从远处投射带侵蚀的弹幕。

en: Retching Broodmother. It continuously spawns Baleful Broodlings, turning the entire seabed into its nest.
_zh: 投嗣育母。它不断产下注亡拟嗣，把整片海床变成自己的巢穴。

en: Chest Sea Seaborn. It has learned to disguise itself as a supply chest, waiting for someone to approach.
_zh: 箱形恐鱼。它学会了伪装成补给箱的模样，等待有人靠近。
_note: 校对：“恐鱼”的官方英文译名为“Sea Terror”，而非“Seaborn”（海嗣）。；官方名未用上：Chest Seaborn

en: Pathshaper. A Seaborn scouting for We Many. It scatters its fragments across every fork in the road, walking the wrong paths first for its kin.
_zh: 塑路者。替大群探路的海嗣，把自己的碎片撒向每一条岔路，先替族群走一遍错路。
_note: 校对：“scouting”在此处作为分词修饰，不应大写。

en: Saint Iberia. Still the same 'Saint', only reduced to this state after the second destruction of his homeland. His cloak is torn, he no longer speaks, and his Hand Cannon only loads one round. He only remembers to eliminate Iberia's enemies one by one before his life burns out.
_zh: 圣徒伊比利亚。还是那位圣徒，只是在家园第二次毁灭之后成了这副模样。斗篷破了，他不再说话，手炮只装一发。他只记得在生命燃尽之前，把伊比利亚的敌人一个个清除。

en: Saint Carmen. The only living 'Saint' of Iberia, his age has long surpassed that of ordinary men, holding a heavy Hand Cannon. The secret arts of life extension have taken his sanity, but he still remembers who the enemy is: step back, reload, aim; when the ammo runs out, he smashes with the cannon itself.
_zh: 圣徒卡门。伊比利亚唯一还活着的圣徒，年纪早已超过常人，手里是一门沉重的手炮。延生的秘术夺走了他的神智，他仍记得谁是敌人：退后，装填，瞄准；弹药打空，就用炮身砸过来。

en: Tidelinked Bishop. A high-ranking cultist of the Church of the Deep. It always appears in pairs with either an Archon or an Immortal, sustaining each other.
_zh: 接潮主教。深海教会的高阶信徒，每次带着蔑死体或斥亡体之一成对出现，彼此维系。

en: Tidelinked Archon. A sturdy melee Seaborn that shares life and death with the bishop.
_zh: 接潮蔑死体。粗壮的近战海嗣，与主教同生共死。

en: Tidelinked Immortal. A swift melee Seaborn that shares life and death with the bishop.
_zh: 接潮斥亡体。迅捷的近战海嗣，与主教同生共死。

en: 'Paranoia Illusion'. She was once an Ægir girl who swallowed Seaborn cells. The wishes of We Many blocked her throat; unable to speak, she could only be dragged by that power, slowly turning into the very thing she hated most.
_zh: 「偏执泡影」。她曾是一名阿戈尔少女，吞下了海嗣的细胞。大群的祈望堵住了她的喉咙，她说不出话，只能被那股力量拖着，一点点变成自己最痛恨的模样。

en: Izumik, Fountain of Ecology. One of the Seaborn broodmothers, offspring continuously surge from its body.
_zh: 伊祖米克，生态泉源。海嗣的母体之一，子代从它身上不断涌出。
_note: 校对：“生态泉源”的官方英文译名为“Fountain of Ecology”。；官方名未用上：Izumik, Source of Ecology

en: The Last Knight, riding Rocinante. He once escorted travelers across Seaborn territory.
_zh: 最后的骑士，骑着罗辛南特。曾护送旅人穿越海嗣领地。

en: A Sea Seaborn that has grown limbs, yet lacks a single bone in its body. It runs like a beast on the shore, bursting open upon pouncing on its prey.
_zh: 长出了四肢的恐鱼，身体里却没有一根骨头。它像岸上的走兽一样奔跑，扑到猎物身边就炸开。
_note: 校对：“恐鱼”的官方英文译名为“Sea Terror”。

en: A floating Sea Seaborn that slowly cruises along the air currents. The things it drops gradually dull the nerves.
_zh: 浮在半空的恐鱼，随气流缓缓游弋。它投下的东西会让神经一点点迟钝。
_note: 校对：“恐鱼”的官方英文译名为“Sea Terror”。

en: A Sea Seaborn that lies on the seabed to store nutrients, occasionally emitting sharp noises. It is almost harmless if left undisturbed; once interrupted, it pursues relentlessly until no other life remains around it.
_zh: 伏在海床上储存养分的恐鱼，偶尔发出尖锐的声响。不去惊动它，它几乎无害；一旦被打断，它会一直追下去，直到四周再没有别的生命。
_note: 校对：“恐鱼”的官方英文译名为“Sea Terror”。

en: A Sea Seaborn bearing a chitinous head shell, yet no corresponding organs can be found beneath it. It walks very slowly; where it falls, Nethersea Brand grows.
_zh: 顶着一副几丁质头壳的恐鱼，壳下却找不到对应的器官。它走得很慢；倒下的地方，溟痕随之生长。
_note: 校对：“恐鱼”的官方英文译名为“Sea Terror”。

en: A Sea Seaborn evolved from a dying swarm. It seeks to smear the last nutrients in its body onto the seabed, moving even more urgently when injured.
_zh: 由濒死的群体衍化而来的恐鱼。它要把身体里最后的养分涂在海床上，受了伤反而走得更急。
_note: 校对：“恐鱼”的官方英文译名为“Sea Terror”。

en: A rare Sea Seaborn surrounded by tiny organisms. Anyone who approaches it will gradually lose sensation in their nerves, even if there is no Nethersea Brand.
_zh: 少见的恐鱼，周身萦绕着细小的生物。靠近它的人，神经会一点点失去知觉，哪怕那里没有溟痕。
_note: 校对：“恐鱼”的官方英文译名为“Sea Terror”。

en: Also uses 'Rock-Chiseling Piercing Shot' to perform a telegraphed attack.
_zh: 另会使用「凿石贯射」进行预警攻击。

en: Approaches slowly and molts upon contact; charges up to release a ring-shaped barrage inflicting minor Corrosion. Also uses 'Carapace Limb Sweep' to perform a telegraphed attack.
_zh: 缓慢接近，接触时蜕变；蓄力后释放带轻度侵蚀的环形弹幕。另会使用「壳肢横扫」进行预警攻击。

en: Offspring thrown by the Retching Broodmother that hatch upon landing. They do not move and gradually wither away; contact and acid bomb hits inflict Corrosion. Fires an acid bomb every 4.2s.
_zh: 由投嗣育母投出、落地孵化的子体，不移动并逐渐衰亡；接触和酸弹命中附加侵蚀，酸弹每 4.2 秒发射一次。

en: Lobs acid at the Leader's predicted position, displaying a warning before landing; hits inflict Corrosion and leave a Nethersea Brand at the impact point. Also uses 'Acid Foam Fan Spit' to perform a telegraphed attack.
_zh: 朝队长预判位置抛射酸液，落地前显示预警；命中附加侵蚀，落点留下溟痕。另会使用「酸沫扇吐」进行预警攻击。
_note: 校对：统一句式，将“for telegraphed attacks”改为与其他条目一致的“to perform a telegraphed attack”。
可能偏长：13 字母 / 中文 2 字

en: Small specimens that sprint close to the ground. Upon reaching the target, they swell for about 0.6s before self-destructing (deals area damage and disappears). Killing them while swelling prevents the explosion; self-destructing specimens do not drop experience.
_zh: 贴地疾跑的小个体，冲到身边后鼓胀约 0.6 秒自爆（范围伤害，自身消失）。鼓胀时击杀可阻止爆炸；自爆的个体不掉经验。
_note: 校对：语法错误，Self-Destruct 在此处作动词应使用动名词形式 self-destructing，且作为普通词汇无需大写。

en: Levitates at the edge of its attack range to fire neural projectiles; projectiles leave a small Nethersea Brand (about 5s) upon hitting or landing. Standing inside accumulates Nervous Impairment. Also uses 'Neural Scattershot' for telegraphed attacks.
_zh: 悬浮在攻击范围边缘发射神经弹；神经弹命中或落地会留下一小片溟痕（约 5 秒），站在里面会累积神经损伤。另会使用「神经散射」进行预警攻击。

en: Dormant on the seabed, awakening when the Leader approaches. Upon taking a hit, it raises a pair of scythe limbs, sprints at increased speed, and slashes forward; the cold blue ripples around it continuously accumulate Nervous Impairment. Reapers among We Many are awake upon appearing. Also uses 'Scythe Limb Thrust' for telegraphed attacks.
_zh: 休眠在海床上，队长靠近时苏醒；受击后高举一对镰肢，提速狂奔并向前劈砍，身周冷蓝波纹持续积累神经损伤。大群里的收割者一出现就是醒着的。另会使用「镰肢直刺」进行预警攻击。

_note: 可能偏长：11 字母 / 中文 2 字
可能偏长：15 字母 / 中文 2 字

en: Heavy Armor and slow-moving. Non-True damage taken -30%; difficult to knockback. Slams the ground with its forelimbs when close. Leaves a Nethersea Brand upon death. Also uses 'Crystal Spike Eruption' for telegraphed attacks.
_zh: 厚甲缓行，受到的非真实伤害 -30%，难以击退；靠近后前肢重击地面。死亡时留下一片溟痕。另会使用「晶刺突起」进行预警攻击。

_note: 可能偏长：15 字母 / 中文 2 字

en: Advances while leaving a trail, and charges up before thrusting forward in a straight line. Becomes Enraged when HP falls below half: movement speed increases, and leaves Nethersea Brands along its path. Also uses 'Tail Blade Reverse Sweep' for telegraphed attacks.
_zh: 拖着尾迹前进，蓄力后直线前刺。生命降到一半以下时狂暴：移速提高，并沿路留下溟痕。另会使用「尾刃反扫」进行预警攻击。

en: Slow-moving tentacles accompanied by a Neural Aura: the Leader accumulates Nervous Impairment every second while inside the aura. Tentacles erupt when close, dealing area damage. Also uses 'Tentacle Scattershot' for telegraphed attacks.
_zh: 触须缓行，身边带着神经光环：队长在光环内每秒累积「神经损伤」。靠近时触须爆发，造成范围伤害。另会使用「触须散射」进行预警攻击。

en: Also uses 'Vesicle Shell Blast' to perform a telegraphed attack.
_zh: 另会使用「囊壳震爆」进行预警攻击。

en: Also uses 'Sea-Skimming Piercing Shot' to perform a telegraphed attack.
_zh: 另会使用「掠海贯射」进行预警攻击。

en: Throws Baleful Broodlings at the Leader: a warning appears at the impact point first, dealing damage and inflicting Corrosion upon landing, then immediately hatches a Broodling (only deals damage when there are 6 Broodlings on the field). Also uses 'Brood Acid Rain' for telegraphed attacks.
_zh: 向队长投掷注亡拟嗣：落点先出预警，落地造成伤害并附加侵蚀，随即孵化一只拟嗣（场上拟嗣到 6 只时只造成伤害）。另会使用「育嗣酸雨」进行预警攻击。

en: Screams for 2.5s after revealing itself: accumulates Nervous Impairment within a 150 radius and consumes Light. Pursues normally but does not bite during this period; defeating it before the Scream ends yields Originium Ingot ×1.5. Bites twice, with the second bite dealing ×0.6 damage. Also uses 'Mimic Tongue Thrust' for telegraphed attacks.
_zh: 现形后尖叫 2.5 秒：周围 150 内累积神经损伤并吞噬灯火，期间照常追击、不啃咬；尖叫结束前击倒，源石锭 ×1.5。啃咬两连，第二口伤害 ×0.6。另会使用「箱舌突刺」进行预警攻击。

en: It scatters its fragments across every fork in the road, letting them walk the wrong paths first.
_zh: 它把自己的碎片撒向每一条岔路，让它们先去走那些错的路。
_note: 候选2：It spreads its fragments across every crossroad, letting them take the wrong paths first.

en: One of the Seaborn broodmothers. Offspring surge from its body, and are absorbed upon their return.
_zh: 海嗣的母体之一。子代从它身上涌出，回到它身上就被吸收。
_note: 候选2：A Seaborn broodmother. Offspring pour from its body, only to be absorbed when they return.

en: His cloak torn, he speaks no more. The Hand Cannon holds only one shot; when empty, he pursues in close combat.
_zh: 斗篷破了，他不再说话。手炮只装一发，打空就贴身追来。

en: Retreat, reload, aim. When out of ammo, he smashes with the cannon barrel.
_zh: 退后、装填、瞄准。弹药打空，就用炮身砸过来。

en: One falling is merely feigned death; only when both fall simultaneously do they truly dissipate.
_zh: 一方倒下只是假死，两者同时倒下才会真正消散。

en: A sturdy melee Seaborn that shares its life with the bishop. Defeating it alone only causes it to feign death for a moment.
_zh: 粗壮的近战海嗣，与主教同生共死，单独击倒只会假死片刻。
_note: 候选2：A robust Melee Seaborn bound to the bishop's life. Defeating it alone merely causes it to feign death briefly.

en: Another Guard of the Tidelinked Bishop
_zh: 接潮主教的另一名护卫

en: A swift melee Seaborn that shares its life with the bishop. Defeating it alone only causes it to feign death for a moment.
_zh: 迅捷的近战海嗣，与主教同生共死，单独击倒只会假死片刻。
_note: 候选2：A fast Melee Seaborn bound to the bishop's life. Defeating it alone merely causes it to feign death briefly.

en: Final · Becoming the Most Hated Form
_zh: 最终 · 变成最厌恶的样子

en: The desires of We Many choked her throat. Dragged by that power, she could only slowly turn into the form she hated most.
_zh: 大群的祈望堵住了她的喉咙，她只能被那股力量拖着，一点点变成自己最痛恨的模样。
_note: 候选2：The wishes of We Many blocked her throat. Pulled by that power, she could only gradually become the form she despised most.

en: Charges up to sprint; attacks inflict Frost Slow for 1.5s on hit. Also uses 'Frost Lance Thrust' to perform a telegraphed attack.
_zh: 蓄力冲刺；攻击命中附加 1.5 秒冰霜减速。另会使用「冰枪点刺」进行预警攻击。

en: Knight's attacks inflict a 2s Frost Slow on hit; the frost domain continuously applies Slow. Frost does not cause a hard Freeze, and a minimum movement speed is retained during the Boss battle.
_zh: 骑士攻击命中附加 2 秒冰霜减速；寒冰领域持续施加减速。冰霜不造成硬冻结，Boss 战仍保留移速下限。

en: The Tide-Hunt Knight who once rode with you.
_note: 猎潮的骑士 官方 Tide-Hunt Knight（trap_079_allydonq）

en: Famous Columbian investor, entrepreneur, and master of 'Duck Power'. Does not attack; flees upon appearing and runs faster when attacked. Slips away if not defeated within 30s. Defeating him guarantees 1 collectible and a small amount of Originium Ingots.
_zh: 哥伦比亚著名投资人、企业家，“鸭之力”大师。不攻击；一出现就逃跑，受到攻击后越跑越快；30 秒内没被击倒就会溜走。击倒必得 1 件藏品与少量源石锭。

en: Accelerates and spreads Nethersea Brand when HP is 50% or lower, taking 35% less Physical damage; launches thrust attacks.
_zh: 生命不高于 50% 时加速并铺设溟痕，受到的物理伤害减少 35%；发动前刺攻击。

en: Aura continuously deals Arts damage and Nervous Impairment; overlapping Arts damage only applies the strongest effect. Stun and Cold duration halved; immune to Halt. Launches tentacle attacks at close range.
_zh: 光环持续造成法术伤害和神经损伤，重叠法伤仅取最强者。眩晕、寒冷时长减半，免疫停顿；近身发动触须攻击。

en: Melee. Extinguishes an additional 8 Light when dashing into the Leader.
_zh: 近战；冲刺撞上队长时额外熄灭 8 点灯火。

en: Throws stones from a distance. Sets up for 20s upon first engaging; Physical damage taken -45% and Arts damage taken +50% during this period.
_zh: 远程投掷碎石。首次接敌架起 20 秒，期间受到的物理伤害减少 45%，法术伤害增加 50%。

en: Izumik's Offspring. Slow-moving but possesses high HP; molts into 2 other Seaborn upon touching the Leader.
_zh: 伊祖米克的子代，行动迟缓但生命很高；碰到队长时蜕变成 2 只其他海嗣。

en: Offspring thrown by the Retching Broodmother that hatch upon landing. They do not move and gradually wither, inflicting Corrosion upon contact.
_zh: 由投嗣育母投出、落地孵化的子体，不会移动并逐渐衰亡，接触造成侵蚀。

en: High-speed fragments released when a Pathshaper shatters.
_zh: 塑路者碎裂时放出的高速碎片。

en: Ranged acid projectiles: warns of the landing point first, deals splash damage upon landing and leaves a Nethersea Brand, inflicting Corrosion on hit.
_zh: 远程抛射酸液：落点先出预警，落地造成范围伤害并留下溟痕，命中附带侵蚀。

en: Summoned by Ishar'mla's humanoid phase using the skill 'Tears of Defiance'. Does not harm the Leader; charges Ishar'mla's transformation when not suppressed. The Leader can suppress it by getting close; disappears after Ishar'mla's transformation.
_zh: 伊莎玛拉人形阶段用技能「抗争之泪」召唤，不会伤害队长；未被压制时为伊莎玛拉的转化充能。队长靠近即可压制，伊莎玛拉转化后消失。

en: Elite. A crawler carrying an air sac. When HP drops to 2/3 and 1/3, it swells for 1.1s and bursts once (range 160); takes no damage while swelling. Move away when it glows.
_zh: 精英。背负气囊的爬行者，生命降到 2/3 和 1/3 时各鼓胀 1.1 秒后爆裂一次（范围 160），鼓胀期间不受伤害；看到它发亮就离开。

en: Elite. A low-altitude levitating ranged entity whose shots inflict Corrosion; falls when controlled, switching to melee.
_zh: 精英。低空悬浮的远程个体，射击附带侵蚀；被控制后坠落，改为近战。
_note: 校对：非专有名词不应大写（levitating, falls, melee）

en: Elite. Throws Baleful Broodlings at the Leader: a warning appears at the impact point first, dealing damage and inflicting Corrosion upon landing. The Broodling then hatches at the impact point (max 6 on the field).
_zh: 精英。向队长投掷注亡拟嗣：落点先出预警，落地造成伤害并附加侵蚀，拟嗣随即在落点孵化（场上最多 6 只）。

en: Elite. Disguised as a supply box, revealing itself when attacked. Screams for 2.5s after revealing itself: accumulates Nervous Impairment within a 150 radius and consumes Light. Pursues normally but does not bite during this period; defeating it before the scream ends yields Originium Ingot ×1.5. Bites twice, with the second bite dealing ×0.6 damage. Immune to Stun, Cold, and Silence; drops Originium Ingots upon defeat.
_zh: 精英。伪装成补给箱，受到攻击后现形。现形后尖叫 2.5 秒：周围 150 内累积神经损伤并吞噬灯火，期间照常追击、不啃咬；尖叫结束前击倒，源石锭 ×1.5。啃咬两连，第二口伤害 ×0.6。免疫眩晕、寒冷和封印；击败后掉落源石锭。
_note: 校对：非专有名词不应大写（scream）

en: Mid-Boss (3:30 / 7:00). Paves a path of life from its feet to the edge of the field, with a signpost at the end of each segment. The Leader running past a signpost severs the path; fractals on the path stop and become priority targets. Stunned for 3s after all paths are severed. Act 1 signposts spit splitting fractal projectiles to both sides, or fire branching branch projectiles at the Leader twice. After HP drops to 50%, a ring of projectiles converges inward toward it with a gap on the path of life, and Ram leaves a row of projectiles along the path that push outward to both sides. Uses 'Ram' and 'Ground Smash' in succession, revealing a flaw after recovery.
_zh: 中期 Boss（3:30 / 7:00）。从脚下向场边铺生路，路线上每段末端有一个路标；队长跑过路标即截断这条路，路上的分形停下并成为优先攻击目标，全部截断后硬直 3 秒。一幕路标向两侧吐出会分裂的分形弹，或朝队长放出两次分叉的树枝弹；生命降到 50% 后，一圈弹从外向它收拢，缺口在生路上，冲撞沿线留下一排向两侧推开的弹。「冲撞」「震地」连续出招，收招后出现破绽。
_note: 校对：非专有名词不应大写（severs, severed, flaw, recovery）；「震地」本表译 Earthshatter，这里没对上

en: Mid-Boss (7:00). Enhanced state of Saint Carmen (the same person; only one appears per run): higher HP and ATK, Hand Cannon only loads 1 round. 'Hand Cannon' fires a beam piercing the entire screen; 'Bombard' fires in an arc at the Leader's position. Both share ammo. Pursues in melee after emptying ammo, using 'Scattershot' at close range to fire 2 waves of 18 pellets each. Reloads for 3s (2.6s in Act 2). Taking cumulative damage or being dashed through during the cast bar interrupts the reload, forcing him to his knees and revealing a flaw. After HP drops to 50%, 'Reload Complete' is followed by a 'Clear Chamber' projectile ring with a gap, then 'Hand Cannon · Triple'.
_zh: 中期 Boss（7:00）。圣徒卡门的强化状态（同一人物，一次探索只会出现一位）：生命与攻击更高，手炮只装 1 发。「手炮」射线贯穿全屏，「轰击」曲射砸向队长所在位置，两者共用弹药；打空后近身追击，近距离用「散射」连喷 2 波、每波 18 发弹丸。装填 3 秒（第二幕 2.6 秒），读条中累计受到伤害或被冲刺穿身会被打断、跪地露出破绽。50% 后装填完毕先放「清膛」缺口环，再接「手炮·三连」。
_note: 校对：非专有名词不应大写（flaw）

en: Mid-Boss (3:30 / 7:00). An elderly 'Saint' wielding a Hand Cannon (the same person as Iberia; only one appears per run): 3 ammo. Ranged 'Sniper', close-range 'Cannon Sweep'. When ammo is full and at a moderate distance, turns around for 'Ring Shot', emptying 3 ammo at once in a bullet ring with three gaps. Reloads for 3s; the cast bar can be interrupted. After 50% HP, emptying ammo first enters an 8s cannon melee, using 'Cannon Smash' to rush to the Leader and smash the ground.
_zh: 中期 Boss（3:30 / 7:00）。持手炮的年迈圣徒（与伊比利亚是同一人物，一次探索只会出现一位）：3 发弹药。远距离「狙击」，近身「炮身横扫」；弹药满且距离适中时转身「环射」，三个缺口的弹环一次打空 3 发。装填 3 秒，读条可被打断。50% 后弹药打空先进入 8 秒炮身近战，用「炮身砸击」冲到队长身边砸地。
_note: 校对：非专有名词不应大写（cannon melee）

en: Mid-Boss (7:00). Appears in pairs with an Archon or Immortal. Enters a feign death state and recovers HP when HP reaches zero; both must feign death simultaneously to be truly defeated. When the HP difference between the two is too large, the one with lower HP takes reduced damage. Both fire projectiles symmetrically along the midline between them: one fires in a fan shape and the other fires a mirror image, or both simultaneously fire projectile rings curving in opposite directions. After either's HP drops to 50%, they swap positions every 10s, deploying a projectile wall along the connecting line that pushes outward to both sides, while both simultaneously fire reverse spirals. The Bishop's 'Tidal Pillar' and the companion's 'Melee' are used in succession, revealing a flaw for both simultaneously after recovery.
_zh: 中期 Boss（7:00）。与蔑死体或斥亡体成对出现；生命归零后进入假死并回复，两者同时假死才会真正倒下。两具血量差过大时，血少的一具受到的伤害降低。两具各自放弹，弹幕关于两体之间的中线对称：一具扇射后另一具放镜像，或两具同时放出反向弯曲的弹环。任一具生命降到 50% 后，每 10 秒互换位置，连线上排出向两侧推开的弹墙，两具同时放反向螺旋。主教「潮汐柱」与同伴近战连续出招，收招后两具同时出现破绽。
_note: 校对：非专有名词不应大写（swap, flaw, recovery）

en: Companion of the Tidelinked Bishop. A sturdy melee Seaborn whose hits inflict Corrosion, and can also feign death. 'Sweep' swings its claws twice consecutively; 'Leap Strike' smashes the Leader's position; 'Corrosive Tide Breath' increases Corrosion damage taken by +25% for 3s on hit. When either's HP drops to 50%, Leap Strike releases a 'Shattertide' blade ring upon landing.
_zh: 接潮主教的同伴。粗壮的近战海嗣，命中附带侵蚀，同样会假死。「横扫」连挥两爪，「跃击」砸向队长所在位置，「蚀潮吐息」命中后 3 秒内侵蚀伤害 +25%；任一具生命降到 50% 后，跃击落地时放出「裂潮」刃环。

en: Companion of the Tidelinked Bishop. A swift melee Seaborn whose hits inflict Corrosion, and can also feign death. 'Multi-Slash' thrusts 3 times consecutively (4 times after 50% HP), attacking in succession with the Bishop's 'Tidal Pillar'. Becomes Enraged and uses 'Burst' when its partner feigns death; also uses Burst upon its own revival.
_zh: 接潮主教的同伴。迅捷的近战海嗣，命中附带侵蚀，同样会假死。「连斩」连续突刺 3 段（50% 后 4 段），与主教「潮汐柱」连续出招；搭档假死时狂暴并「迸发」，自己复苏时也会迸发。
_note: 校对：过度翻译，“搭档”应直译为 partner，不应替换为特定专有名词 Al-Rafiq。

en: Final Boss of Ending 1 'Precious Days'. Seven active attacks: 'Gaze' fires beams aiming sequentially; 'Overlapping Shadows' tracks the Leader anew each segment; 'Bubble Ring' fires a ring of projectiles with a gap; 'Howl' spews in a fan shape; 'Pursuit Bubble' tracks briefly before moving straight; 'Phantom Encirclement' fires beams from both sides; 'Bubble Convergence' closes a cluster of bubbles inward, leaving an exit. Cognitive Burden aura reduces squad ASPD. Falls when HP drops to half. Enters Cocoon when HP reaches zero for the first time, reviving with 50% Max HP.
_zh: 结局一「平凡即是喜乐」的最终 Boss。七种主动攻击：「凝视」依次瞄准的光束；「叠影」每段重新追踪队长；「泡影环」缺口弹环；「呼号」扇形喷涌；「追猎泡」短时追踪后直行；「幻影合围」两侧光束；「泡影收束」向内合拢的泡群，留有出口。认知负担光环降低全队攻速。生命降至一半时坠落，首次归零后结茧，复苏时恢复至最大生命的 50%。

en: Final Boss of Ending 4 'Stella Caerula'. Invincible during the Learning phase; offspring slowly approach the main body from the edge of the field. Triggers Share after absorbing offspring. During the Elucidation phase, uses attacks in successive groups by act, revealing a Flaw at the end of each group: 'Tidal Fall', 'Deciphering Vortex', 'Share', 'Shock', 'Protective Tentacle', 'Migration Tide', and 'Abyssal Surge', as well as swaying water current projectiles, Offspring Resonance, Spiral Arm, Learned Shots that Halt before turning, and Backflow Shots that roll back. Water currents leave a path in the direction the offspring come from; offspring walking on the path will also fire projectiles. The more stacks absorbed, the more Learned Shots fired. Migration Tide crosses the field and leaves a path. Abyssal Surge forms an inward-converging ring. Shock and Act 3's 'Share · Global' can be dodged by dashing or standing inside the Beacon Ring of a lit Lamp Pillar. Lamp Pillars do not block other projectiles.
_zh: 结局四「如星空般深蓝」的最终 Boss。学习阶段无敌，子代从场边缓慢靠近本体；吸收子代后发动分享。阐释阶段按幕成组连续出招，每组结束露出破绽：「潮汐坠落」「解读旋涡」「分享」「震撼」「护群触腕」「迁徙潮」「深渊涌流」，以及摆动的水流弹、子代共鸣、螺旋弹臂、停顿后转向的习得弹、卷回的回流弹。水流在子代来向留出通道；走在路上的子代会跟着放弹，吸收层数越多习得弹越多。迁徙潮横穿场地并留有通道，涌流形成向内收拢的环带。震撼与三幕的分享·全场可通过冲刺或站进点亮的灯柱光圈躲避，灯柱不挡别的弹。

en: Final Boss of Ending 3 'Price of Peace'. Humanoid phase cannot be attacked; heals Seaborn and enhances them into Elites, marking enhanced targets with a red outline. Three teardrops each sustain one Elite; touching a teardrop permanently purifies it and removes the corresponding enhancement. Unpurified tears accelerate transformation, becoming destructible Song Eyes after transforming. Hostile form has seven active attacks: 'Falling Tears', 'Triple-Line Sweep', 'Song of We Many', 'Bite', 'Chorus Volley', 'Encroaching Chorus', and 'Abyssal Tentacle'. Eliminating chorus Seaborn weakens Chorus Volley and Encroaching Chorus. Destroying Song Eyes interrupts Teardrop Resonance and removes the corresponding Elite enhancement.
_zh: 结局三「息潮的代价」的最终 Boss。人形阶段不受攻击，治疗海嗣并将其强化为精英，红色描边标记强化目标。三枚泪滴各维持一名精英；触碰泪滴可永久净化并解除对应强化。未净化的泪加快转化，转化后成为可破坏的歌眼。敌对形态有七种主动攻击：「泪落」「三线扫射」「大群之歌」「撕咬」「合唱齐射」「合唱压境」「深海触腕」。拆除合唱海嗣可削弱齐射与压境，击破歌眼可中断泪滴共鸣并解除对应精英强化。

en: Final Boss of Ending 2 'Age of the Silence'. Eight active attacks: 'Charge', 'Frost Line', 'Lance Combo', 'Throw Spear', 'Lance Spin', 'Ice-Shattering Stomp', 'Tide-Severing Cleave', and 'Side-Step Upward Thrust'. Frost Line is followed by Cold Pursuit. Ice-Shattering Stomp blocks three paths. Tide-Severing Cleave advances forward. Side-steps before re-aiming for Upward Thrust. Phase 1 deploys five ice pillars; the next batch spawns only after all are shattered by ramming. Revives from ice when HP reaches zero for the first time; remaining pillars shatter and no longer spawn, Charge extends to three segments. Taking cumulative hits triggers a Cold counterattack.
_zh: 结局二「静谧时代」的最终 Boss。八种主动攻击：「冲锋」「冰线」「长枪连刺」「掷枪」「长枪回旋」「踏冰裂阵」「断潮劈击」「侧踏挑枪」。冰线后接寒冷追击，裂阵封锁三条通道，劈击向前推进，侧踏后重新瞄准挑枪。一阶段布置五根冰柱，全部撞碎后才生成下一批。首次生命归零后寒冰重生，残柱碎裂且不再生成，冲锋接续三段；累积受击可触发寒冷反击。

en: Elite. The Last Knight, appearing only after the Tide-Hunt Knight (Ending 2 route) falls. Charges in a straight line, inflicting Frost Slow on hit.
_zh: 精英。最后的骑士，只在猎潮的骑士（结局二路线）倒下后出现。直线冲锋，命中附带冰霜减速。

en: Feigned Death · Defeat the other within %ds
_zh: 假死 · %d 秒内击倒另一体
伊莎玛拉 完成了转化！
_note: 校对：遗漏了中文原文本中的感叹号。
初稿用了集成战略的 Objective Shield，这里是队长护盾

en: Voice of We Many · Dual Beam

_zh: 合唱成墙 · 冲刺穿过

en: Heals linked Seaborn when the song ends
_zh: 歌声结束时治疗连线海嗣

en: Song of Encirclement · Find the Gap
Song of Rebirth · Break net to interrupt
_zh: 重生之歌 · 拆网打断

en: She sinks into the center · Enclosing Song
_zh: 她沉入场心 · 歌声围拢
伊祖米克进入「阐释」阶段！
_note: 横幅保留感叹号（原文有）

en: Ice Ridge: Charge leaves ice paths, begins to Throw Spear
_zh: 冰棱带：冲锋会留下冰面，开始掷枪

en: Cold Wave: Double Throw Spear, Charge will turn back
_zh: 寒潮：掷枪两连，冲锋会折返

en: Charge form: Lure it to crash into the edge to Stun it
_zh: 冲锋形态：引它撞上场边就会眩晕
"偏执泡影" 结茧 —— 打破外壳

en: Echo of We Many + Bubble Convergence

keys: 最常见的海嗣个体。它们成群地漂过海床，像被潮水推着的白骨，任何靠近的温热之物都会引来它们的撕咬。
en: The most common Seaborn specimen. They drift across the seabed in swarms like white bones pushed by the tide; any warm object that approaches draws their bite.

keys: 贴着海床滑行的海嗣，动作比看上去快得多。被它撞上的人，手里的灯会猛地一暗。
en: A Seaborn that slides along the seabed, moving much faster than it appears. Anyone it rams into will find the lamp in their hands suddenly dimming.

keys: 背着岩壳的海嗣，习惯把自己半埋进海床，再把凿下的碎石抛向来者。
en: A Seaborn carrying a rock shell. It tends to half-bury itself in the seabed, then hurl chiseled rubble at intruders.

keys: 伊祖米克的子代。缓慢、臃肿，生命力惊人，碰到猎物后会蜕变成别的海嗣。
en: Izumik's Offspring. Slow, bloated, and possessing astonishing vitality. Upon touching prey, it molts into another Seaborn.

keys: 投嗣育母产下的诱饵。它们不会移动，只会缓缓衰亡，并在衰亡前喷出腐蚀性的酸液。
en: Bait spawned by the Retching Broodmother. They do not move, only slowly wither, spewing corrosive acid before their demise.

keys: 在海中喷吐的初速极快，足以击碎礁石。酸液落下的地方，留下一片溟痕。
en: Its spit in the sea has an extremely high initial velocity, enough to shatter reefs. Where the acid lands, a patch of Nethersea Brand is left behind.

keys: 塑路者受到重创时剥落的碎片，替母体去试那些走不通的路。
en: Fragments peeled off when a Pathshaper is severely wounded, testing impassable paths for their mother.

keys: 伊莎玛拉渗出的泪滴，停在原地，替她积蓄转化所需的力量。
en: A teardrop shed by Ishar'mla. It remains in place, accumulating the power she needs for her transformation.

keys: 背负着气囊的爬行者。囊内是高压的腐蚀性液体，它的死亡就是一次爆裂。
en: A crawler carrying an air sac. Inside is highly pressurized corrosive liquid; its death is a violent burst.

keys: 低空悬浮的海嗣，用飘忽的移动躲避攻击，并从远处投射带侵蚀的弹幕。
en: A low-altitude Levitating Seaborn. It evades attacks with erratic movements and projects barrages inflicting Corrosion from afar.

keys: 投嗣育母。它不断产下注亡拟嗣，把整片海床变成自己的巢穴。
en: Retching Broodmother. It continuously spawns Baleful Broodlings, turning the entire seabed into its nest.

keys: 箱形恐鱼。它学会了伪装成补给箱的模样，等待有人靠近。
en: Chest Sea Seaborn. It has learned to disguise itself as a supply chest, waiting for someone to approach.

keys: 塑路者。替大群探路的海嗣，把自己的碎片撒向每一条岔路，先替族群走一遍错路。
en: Pathshaper. A Seaborn scouting for We Many. It scatters its fragments across every fork in the road, walking the wrong paths first for its kin.

keys: 圣徒伊比利亚。还是那位圣徒，只是在家园第二次毁灭之后成了这副模样。斗篷破了，他不再说话，手炮只装一发。他只记得在生命燃尽之前，把伊比利亚的敌人一个个清除。
en: Saint Iberia. Still the same 'Saint', only reduced to this state after the second destruction of his homeland. His cloak is torn, he no longer speaks, and his Hand Cannon only loads one round. He only remembers to eliminate Iberia's enemies one by one before his life burns out.

keys: 圣徒卡门。伊比利亚唯一还活着的圣徒，年纪早已超过常人，手里是一门沉重的手炮。延生的秘术夺走了他的神智，他仍记得谁是敌人：退后，装填，瞄准；弹药打空，就用炮身砸过来。
en: Saint Carmen. The only living 'Saint' of Iberia, his age has long surpassed that of ordinary men, holding a heavy Hand Cannon. The secret arts of life extension have taken his sanity, but he still remembers who the enemy is: step back, reload, aim; when the ammo runs out, he smashes with the cannon itself.

keys: 接潮主教。深海教会的高阶信徒，每次带着蔑死体或斥亡体之一成对出现，彼此维系。
en: Tidelinked Bishop. A high-ranking cultist of the Church of the Deep. It always appears in pairs with either an Archon or an Immortal, sustaining each other.

keys: 接潮蔑死体。粗壮的近战海嗣，与主教同生共死。
en: Tidelinked Archon. A sturdy melee Seaborn that shares life and death with the bishop.

keys: 接潮斥亡体。迅捷的近战海嗣，与主教同生共死。
en: Tidelinked Immortal. A swift melee Seaborn that shares life and death with the bishop.

keys: 「偏执泡影」。她曾是一名阿戈尔少女，吞下了海嗣的细胞。大群的祈望堵住了她的喉咙，她说不出话，只能被那股力量拖着，一点点变成自己最痛恨的模样。
en: 'Paranoia Illusion'. She was once an Ægir girl who swallowed Seaborn cells. The wishes of We Many blocked her throat; unable to speak, she could only be dragged by that power, slowly turning into the very thing she hated most.

keys: 伊祖米克，生态泉源。海嗣的母体之一，子代从它身上不断涌出。
en: Izumik, Fountain of Ecology. One of the Seaborn broodmothers, offspring continuously surge from its body.

keys: 最后的骑士，骑着罗辛南特。曾护送旅人穿越海嗣领地。
en: The Last Knight, riding Rocinante. He once escorted travelers across Seaborn territory.

keys: 长出了四肢的恐鱼，身体里却没有一根骨头。它像岸上的走兽一样奔跑，扑到猎物身边就炸开。
en: A Sea Seaborn that has grown limbs, yet lacks a single bone in its body. It runs like a beast on the shore, bursting open upon pouncing on its prey.

keys: 浮在半空的恐鱼，随气流缓缓游弋。它投下的东西会让神经一点点迟钝。
en: A floating Sea Seaborn that slowly cruises along the air currents. The things it drops gradually dull the nerves.

keys: 伏在海床上储存养分的恐鱼，偶尔发出尖锐的声响。不去惊动它，它几乎无害；一旦被打断，它会一直追下去，直到四周再没有别的生命。
en: A Sea Seaborn that lies on the seabed to store nutrients, occasionally emitting sharp noises. It is almost harmless if left undisturbed; once interrupted, it pursues relentlessly until no other life remains around it.

keys: 顶着一副几丁质头壳的恐鱼，壳下却找不到对应的器官。它走得很慢；倒下的地方，溟痕随之生长。
en: A Sea Seaborn bearing a chitinous head shell, yet no corresponding organs can be found beneath it. It walks very slowly; where it falls, Nethersea Brand grows.

keys: 由濒死的群体衍化而来的恐鱼。它要把身体里最后的养分涂在海床上，受了伤反而走得更急。
en: A Sea Seaborn evolved from a dying swarm. It seeks to smear the last nutrients in its body onto the seabed, moving even more urgently when injured.

keys: 少见的恐鱼，周身萦绕着细小的生物。靠近它的人，神经会一点点失去知觉，哪怕那里没有溟痕。
en: A rare Sea Seaborn surrounded by tiny organisms. Anyone who approaches it will gradually lose sensation in their nerves, even if there is no Nethersea Brand.

keys: 另会使用「凿石贯射」进行预警攻击。
en: Also uses 'Rock-Chiseling Piercing Shot' to perform a telegraphed attack.

keys: 缓慢接近，接触时蜕变；蓄力后释放带轻度侵蚀的环形弹幕。另会使用「壳肢横扫」进行预警攻击。
en: Approaches slowly and molts upon contact; charges up to release a ring-shaped barrage inflicting minor Corrosion. Also uses 'Carapace Limb Sweep' to perform a telegraphed attack.

keys: 由投嗣育母投出、落地孵化的子体，不移动并逐渐衰亡；接触和酸弹命中附加侵蚀，酸弹每 4.2 秒发射一次。
en: Offspring thrown by the Retching Broodmother that hatch upon landing. They do not move and gradually wither away; contact and acid bomb hits inflict Corrosion. Fires an acid bomb every 4.2s.

keys: 朝队长预判位置抛射酸液，落地前显示预警；命中附加侵蚀，落点留下溟痕。另会使用「酸沫扇吐」进行预警攻击。
en: Lobs acid at the Leader's predicted position, displaying a warning before landing; hits inflict Corrosion and leave a Nethersea Brand at the impact point. Also uses 'Acid Foam Fan Spit' to perform a telegraphed attack.

keys: 贴地疾跑的小个体，冲到身边后鼓胀约 0.6 秒自爆（范围伤害，自身消失）。鼓胀时击杀可阻止爆炸；自爆的个体不掉经验。
en: Small specimens that sprint close to the ground. Upon reaching the target, they swell for about 0.6s before self-destructing (deals area damage and disappears). Killing them while swelling prevents the explosion; self-destructing specimens do not drop experience.

keys: 悬浮在攻击范围边缘发射神经弹；神经弹命中或落地会留下一小片溟痕（约 5 秒），站在里面会累积神经损伤。另会使用「神经散射」进行预警攻击。
en: Levitates at the edge of its attack range to fire neural projectiles; projectiles leave a small Nethersea Brand (about 5s) upon hitting or landing. Standing inside accumulates Nervous Impairment. Also uses 'Neural Scattershot' for telegraphed attacks.

keys: 休眠在海床上，队长靠近时苏醒；受击后高举一对镰肢，提速狂奔并向前劈砍，身周冷蓝波纹持续积累神经损伤。大群里的收割者一出现就是醒着的。另会使用「镰肢直刺」进行预警攻击。
en: Dormant on the seabed, awakening when the Leader approaches. Upon taking a hit, it raises a pair of scythe limbs, sprints at increased speed, and slashes forward; the cold blue ripples around it continuously accumulate Nervous Impairment. Reapers among We Many are awake upon appearing. Also uses 'Scythe Limb Thrust' for telegraphed attacks.

keys: 厚甲缓行，受到的非真实伤害 -30%，难以击退；靠近后前肢重击地面。死亡时留下一片溟痕。另会使用「晶刺突起」进行预警攻击。
en: Heavy Armor and slow-moving. Non-True damage taken -30%; difficult to knockback. Slams the ground with its forelimbs when close. Leaves a Nethersea Brand upon death. Also uses 'Crystal Spike Eruption' for telegraphed attacks.

keys: 拖着尾迹前进，蓄力后直线前刺。生命降到一半以下时狂暴：移速提高，并沿路留下溟痕。另会使用「尾刃反扫」进行预警攻击。
en: Advances while leaving a trail, and charges up before thrusting forward in a straight line. Becomes Enraged when HP falls below half: movement speed increases, and leaves Nethersea Brands along its path. Also uses 'Tail Blade Reverse Sweep' for telegraphed attacks.

keys: 触须缓行，身边带着神经光环：队长在光环内每秒累积「神经损伤」。靠近时触须爆发，造成范围伤害。另会使用「触须散射」进行预警攻击。
en: Slow-moving tentacles accompanied by a Neural Aura: the Leader accumulates Nervous Impairment every second while inside the aura. Tentacles erupt when close, dealing area damage. Also uses 'Tentacle Scattershot' for telegraphed attacks.

keys: 另会使用「囊壳震爆」进行预警攻击。
en: Also uses 'Vesicle Shell Blast' to perform a telegraphed attack.

keys: 另会使用「掠海贯射」进行预警攻击。
en: Also uses 'Sea-Skimming Piercing Shot' to perform a telegraphed attack.

keys: 向队长投掷注亡拟嗣：落点先出预警，落地造成伤害并附加侵蚀，随即孵化一只拟嗣（场上拟嗣到 6 只时只造成伤害）。另会使用「育嗣酸雨」进行预警攻击。
en: Throws Baleful Broodlings at the Leader: a warning appears at the impact point first, dealing damage and inflicting Corrosion upon landing, then immediately hatches a Broodling (only deals damage when there are 6 Broodlings on the field). Also uses 'Brood Acid Rain' for telegraphed attacks.

keys: 现形后尖叫 2.5 秒：周围 150 内累积神经损伤并吞噬灯火，期间照常追击、不啃咬；尖叫结束前击倒，源石锭 ×1.5。啃咬两连，第二口伤害 ×0.6。另会使用「箱舌突刺」进行预警攻击。
en: Screams for 2.5s after revealing itself: accumulates Nervous Impairment within a 150 radius and consumes Light. Pursues normally but does not bite during this period; defeating it before the Scream ends yields Originium Ingot ×1.5. Bites twice, with the second bite dealing ×0.6 damage. Also uses 'Mimic Tongue Thrust' for telegraphed attacks.

keys: 它把自己的碎片撒向每一条岔路，让它们先去走那些错的路。
en: It scatters its fragments across every fork in the road, letting them walk the wrong paths first.

keys: 海嗣的母体之一。子代从它身上涌出，回到它身上就被吸收。
en: One of the Seaborn broodmothers. Offspring surge from its body, and are absorbed upon their return.

keys: 斗篷破了，他不再说话。手炮只装一发，打空就贴身追来。
en: His cloak torn, he speaks no more. The Hand Cannon holds only one shot; when empty, he pursues in close combat.

keys: 退后、装填、瞄准。弹药打空，就用炮身砸过来。
en: Retreat, reload, aim. When out of ammo, he smashes with the cannon barrel.

keys: 一方倒下只是假死，两者同时倒下才会真正消散。
en: One falling is merely feigned death; only when both fall simultaneously do they truly dissipate.

keys: 粗壮的近战海嗣，与主教同生共死，单独击倒只会假死片刻。
en: A sturdy melee Seaborn that shares its life with the bishop. Defeating it alone only causes it to feign death for a moment.

keys: 接潮主教的另一名护卫
en: Another Guard of the Tidelinked Bishop

keys: 迅捷的近战海嗣，与主教同生共死，单独击倒只会假死片刻。
en: A swift melee Seaborn that shares its life with the bishop. Defeating it alone only causes it to feign death for a moment.

keys: 最终 · 变成最厌恶的样子
en: Final · Becoming the Most Hated Form

keys: 大群的祈望堵住了她的喉咙，她只能被那股力量拖着，一点点变成自己最痛恨的模样。
en: The desires of We Many choked her throat. Dragged by that power, she could only slowly turn into the form she hated most.

keys: 蓄力冲刺；攻击命中附加 1.5 秒冰霜减速。另会使用「冰枪点刺」进行预警攻击。
en: Charges up to sprint; attacks inflict Frost Slow for 1.5s on hit. Also uses 'Frost Lance Thrust' to perform a telegraphed attack.

keys: 骑士攻击命中附加 2 秒冰霜减速；寒冰领域持续施加减速。冰霜不造成硬冻结，Boss 战仍保留移速下限。
en: Knight's attacks inflict a 2s Frost Slow on hit; the frost domain continuously applies Slow. Frost does not cause a hard Freeze, and a minimum movement speed is retained during the Boss battle.
The Tide-Hunt Knight who once rode with you.

keys: 哥伦比亚著名投资人、企业家，“鸭之力”大师。不攻击；一出现就逃跑，受到攻击后越跑越快；30 秒内没被击倒就会溜走。击倒必得 1 件藏品与少量源石锭。
en: Famous Columbian investor, entrepreneur, and master of 'Duck Power'. Does not attack; flees upon appearing and runs faster when attacked. Slips away if not defeated within 30s. Defeating him guarantees 1 collectible and a small amount of Originium Ingots.

keys: 生命不高于 50% 时加速并铺设溟痕，受到的物理伤害减少 35%；发动前刺攻击。
en: Accelerates and spreads Nethersea Brand when HP is 50% or lower, taking 35% less Physical damage; launches thrust attacks.

keys: 光环持续造成法术伤害和神经损伤，重叠法伤仅取最强者。眩晕、寒冷时长减半，免疫停顿；近身发动触须攻击。
en: Aura continuously deals Arts damage and Nervous Impairment; overlapping Arts damage only applies the strongest effect. Stun and Cold duration halved; immune to Halt. Launches tentacle attacks at close range.

keys: 近战；冲刺撞上队长时额外熄灭 8 点灯火。
en: Melee. Extinguishes an additional 8 Light when dashing into the Leader.

keys: 远程投掷碎石。首次接敌架起 20 秒，期间受到的物理伤害减少 45%，法术伤害增加 50%。
en: Throws stones from a distance. Sets up for 20s upon first engaging; Physical damage taken -45% and Arts damage taken +50% during this period.

keys: 伊祖米克的子代，行动迟缓但生命很高；碰到队长时蜕变成 2 只其他海嗣。
en: Izumik's Offspring. Slow-moving but possesses high HP; molts into 2 other Seaborn upon touching the Leader.

keys: 由投嗣育母投出、落地孵化的子体，不会移动并逐渐衰亡，接触造成侵蚀。
en: Offspring thrown by the Retching Broodmother that hatch upon landing. They do not move and gradually wither, inflicting Corrosion upon contact.

keys: 塑路者碎裂时放出的高速碎片。
en: High-speed fragments released when a Pathshaper shatters.

keys: 远程抛射酸液：落点先出预警，落地造成范围伤害并留下溟痕，命中附带侵蚀。
en: Ranged acid projectiles: warns of the landing point first, deals splash damage upon landing and leaves a Nethersea Brand, inflicting Corrosion on hit.

keys: 伊莎玛拉人形阶段用技能「抗争之泪」召唤，不会伤害队长；未被压制时为伊莎玛拉的转化充能。队长靠近即可压制，伊莎玛拉转化后消失。
en: Summoned by Ishar'mla's humanoid phase using the skill 'Tears of Defiance'. Does not harm the Leader; charges Ishar'mla's transformation when not suppressed. The Leader can suppress it by getting close; disappears after Ishar'mla's transformation.

keys: 精英。背负气囊的爬行者，生命降到 2/3 和 1/3 时各鼓胀 1.1 秒后爆裂一次（范围 160），鼓胀期间不受伤害；看到它发亮就离开。
en: Elite. A crawler carrying an air sac. When HP drops to 2/3 and 1/3, it swells for 1.1s and bursts once (range 160); takes no damage while swelling. Move away when it glows.

keys: 精英。低空悬浮的远程个体，射击附带侵蚀；被控制后坠落，改为近战。
en: Elite. A low-altitude levitating ranged entity whose shots inflict Corrosion; falls when controlled, switching to melee.

keys: 精英。向队长投掷注亡拟嗣：落点先出预警，落地造成伤害并附加侵蚀，拟嗣随即在落点孵化（场上最多 6 只）。
en: Elite. Throws Baleful Broodlings at the Leader: a warning appears at the impact point first, dealing damage and inflicting Corrosion upon landing. The Broodling then hatches at the impact point (max 6 on the field).

keys: 精英。伪装成补给箱，受到攻击后现形。现形后尖叫 2.5 秒：周围 150 内累积神经损伤并吞噬灯火，期间照常追击、不啃咬；尖叫结束前击倒，源石锭 ×1.5。啃咬两连，第二口伤害 ×0.6。免疫眩晕、寒冷和封印；击败后掉落源石锭。
en: Elite. Disguised as a supply box, revealing itself when attacked. Screams for 2.5s after revealing itself: accumulates Nervous Impairment within a 150 radius and consumes Light. Pursues normally but does not bite during this period; defeating it before the scream ends yields Originium Ingot ×1.5. Bites twice, with the second bite dealing ×0.6 damage. Immune to Stun, Cold, and Silence; drops Originium Ingots upon defeat.

keys: 中期 Boss（3:30 / 7:00）。从脚下向场边铺生路，路线上每段末端有一个路标；队长跑过路标即截断这条路，路上的分形停下并成为优先攻击目标，全部截断后硬直 3 秒。一幕路标向两侧吐出会分裂的分形弹，或朝队长放出两次分叉的树枝弹；生命降到 50% 后，一圈弹从外向它收拢，缺口在生路上，冲撞沿线留下一排向两侧推开的弹。「冲撞」「震地」连续出招，收招后出现破绽。
en: Mid-Boss (3:30 / 7:00). Paves a path of life from its feet to the edge of the field, with a signpost at the end of each segment. The Leader running past a signpost severs the path; fractals on the path stop and become priority targets. Stunned for 3s after all paths are severed. Act 1 signposts spit splitting fractal projectiles to both sides, or fire branching branch projectiles at the Leader twice. After HP drops to 50%, a ring of projectiles converges inward toward it with a gap on the path of life, and Ram leaves a row of projectiles along the path that push outward to both sides. Uses 'Ram' and 'Ground Smash' in succession, revealing a flaw after recovery.

keys: 中期 Boss（7:00）。圣徒卡门的强化状态（同一人物，一次探索只会出现一位）：生命与攻击更高，手炮只装 1 发。「手炮」射线贯穿全屏，「轰击」曲射砸向队长所在位置，两者共用弹药；打空后近身追击，近距离用「散射」连喷 2 波、每波 18 发弹丸。装填 3 秒（第二幕 2.6 秒），读条中累计受到伤害或被冲刺穿身会被打断、跪地露出破绽。50% 后装填完毕先放「清膛」缺口环，再接「手炮·三连」。
en: Mid-Boss (7:00). Enhanced state of Saint Carmen (the same person; only one appears per run): higher HP and ATK, Hand Cannon only loads 1 round. 'Hand Cannon' fires a beam piercing the entire screen; 'Bombard' fires in an arc at the Leader's position. Both share ammo. Pursues in melee after emptying ammo, using 'Scattershot' at close range to fire 2 waves of 18 pellets each. Reloads for 3s (2.6s in Act 2). Taking cumulative damage or being dashed through during the cast bar interrupts the reload, forcing him to his knees and revealing a flaw. After HP drops to 50%, 'Reload Complete' is followed by a 'Clear Chamber' projectile ring with a gap, then 'Hand Cannon · Triple'.

keys: 中期 Boss（3:30 / 7:00）。持手炮的年迈圣徒（与伊比利亚是同一人物，一次探索只会出现一位）：3 发弹药。远距离「狙击」，近身「炮身横扫」；弹药满且距离适中时转身「环射」，三个缺口的弹环一次打空 3 发。装填 3 秒，读条可被打断。50% 后弹药打空先进入 8 秒炮身近战，用「炮身砸击」冲到队长身边砸地。
en: Mid-Boss (3:30 / 7:00). An elderly 'Saint' wielding a Hand Cannon (the same person as Iberia; only one appears per run): 3 ammo. Ranged 'Sniper', close-range 'Cannon Sweep'. When ammo is full and at a moderate distance, turns around for 'Ring Shot', emptying 3 ammo at once in a bullet ring with three gaps. Reloads for 3s; the cast bar can be interrupted. After 50% HP, emptying ammo first enters an 8s cannon melee, using 'Cannon Smash' to rush to the Leader and smash the ground.

keys: 中期 Boss（7:00）。与蔑死体或斥亡体成对出现；生命归零后进入假死并回复，两者同时假死才会真正倒下。两具血量差过大时，血少的一具受到的伤害降低。两具各自放弹，弹幕关于两体之间的中线对称：一具扇射后另一具放镜像，或两具同时放出反向弯曲的弹环。任一具生命降到 50% 后，每 10 秒互换位置，连线上排出向两侧推开的弹墙，两具同时放反向螺旋。主教「潮汐柱」与同伴近战连续出招，收招后两具同时出现破绽。
en: Mid-Boss (7:00). Appears in pairs with an Archon or Immortal. Enters a feign death state and recovers HP when HP reaches zero; both must feign death simultaneously to be truly defeated. When the HP difference between the two is too large, the one with lower HP takes reduced damage. Both fire projectiles symmetrically along the midline between them: one fires in a fan shape and the other fires a mirror image, or both simultaneously fire projectile rings curving in opposite directions. After either's HP drops to 50%, they swap positions every 10s, deploying a projectile wall along the connecting line that pushes outward to both sides, while both simultaneously fire reverse spirals. The Bishop's 'Tidal Pillar' and the companion's 'Melee' are used in succession, revealing a flaw for both simultaneously after recovery.

keys: 接潮主教的同伴。粗壮的近战海嗣，命中附带侵蚀，同样会假死。「横扫」连挥两爪，「跃击」砸向队长所在位置，「蚀潮吐息」命中后 3 秒内侵蚀伤害 +25%；任一具生命降到 50% 后，跃击落地时放出「裂潮」刃环。
en: Companion of the Tidelinked Bishop. A sturdy melee Seaborn whose hits inflict Corrosion, and can also feign death. 'Sweep' swings its claws twice consecutively; 'Leap Strike' smashes the Leader's position; 'Corrosive Tide Breath' increases Corrosion damage taken by +25% for 3s on hit. When either's HP drops to 50%, Leap Strike releases a 'Shattertide' blade ring upon landing.

keys: 接潮主教的同伴。迅捷的近战海嗣，命中附带侵蚀，同样会假死。「连斩」连续突刺 3 段（50% 后 4 段），与主教「潮汐柱」连续出招；搭档假死时狂暴并「迸发」，自己复苏时也会迸发。
en: Companion of the Tidelinked Bishop. A swift melee Seaborn whose hits inflict Corrosion, and can also feign death. 'Multi-Slash' thrusts 3 times consecutively (4 times after 50% HP), attacking in succession with the Bishop's 'Tidal Pillar'. Becomes Enraged and uses 'Burst' when its partner feigns death; also uses Burst upon its own revival.

keys: 结局一「平凡即是喜乐」的最终 Boss。七种主动攻击：「凝视」依次瞄准的光束；「叠影」每段重新追踪队长；「泡影环」缺口弹环；「呼号」扇形喷涌；「追猎泡」短时追踪后直行；「幻影合围」两侧光束；「泡影收束」向内合拢的泡群，留有出口。认知负担光环降低全队攻速。生命降至一半时坠落，首次归零后结茧，复苏时恢复至最大生命的 50%。
en: Final Boss of Ending 1 'Precious Days'. Seven active attacks: 'Gaze' fires beams aiming sequentially; 'Overlapping Shadows' tracks the Leader anew each segment; 'Bubble Ring' fires a ring of projectiles with a gap; 'Howl' spews in a fan shape; 'Pursuit Bubble' tracks briefly before moving straight; 'Phantom Encirclement' fires beams from both sides; 'Bubble Convergence' closes a cluster of bubbles inward, leaving an exit. Cognitive Burden aura reduces squad ASPD. Falls when HP drops to half. Enters Cocoon when HP reaches zero for the first time, reviving with 50% Max HP.

keys: 结局四「如星空般深蓝」的最终 Boss。学习阶段无敌，子代从场边缓慢靠近本体；吸收子代后发动分享。阐释阶段按幕成组连续出招，每组结束露出破绽：「潮汐坠落」「解读旋涡」「分享」「震撼」「护群触腕」「迁徙潮」「深渊涌流」，以及摆动的水流弹、子代共鸣、螺旋弹臂、停顿后转向的习得弹、卷回的回流弹。水流在子代来向留出通道；走在路上的子代会跟着放弹，吸收层数越多习得弹越多。迁徙潮横穿场地并留有通道，涌流形成向内收拢的环带。震撼与三幕的分享·全场可通过冲刺或站进点亮的灯柱光圈躲避，灯柱不挡别的弹。
en: Final Boss of Ending 4 'Stella Caerula'. Invincible during the Learning phase; offspring slowly approach the main body from the edge of the field. Triggers Share after absorbing offspring. During the Elucidation phase, uses attacks in successive groups by act, revealing a Flaw at the end of each group: 'Tidal Fall', 'Deciphering Vortex', 'Share', 'Shock', 'Protective Tentacle', 'Migration Tide', and 'Abyssal Surge', as well as swaying water current projectiles, Offspring Resonance, Spiral Arm, Learned Shots that Halt before turning, and Backflow Shots that roll back. Water currents leave a path in the direction the offspring come from; offspring walking on the path will also fire projectiles. The more stacks absorbed, the more Learned Shots fired. Migration Tide crosses the field and leaves a path. Abyssal Surge forms an inward-converging ring. Shock and Act 3's 'Share · Global' can be dodged by dashing or standing inside the Beacon Ring of a lit Lamp Pillar. Lamp Pillars do not block other projectiles.

keys: 结局三「息潮的代价」的最终 Boss。人形阶段不受攻击，治疗海嗣并将其强化为精英，红色描边标记强化目标。三枚泪滴各维持一名精英；触碰泪滴可永久净化并解除对应强化。未净化的泪加快转化，转化后成为可破坏的歌眼。敌对形态有七种主动攻击：「泪落」「三线扫射」「大群之歌」「撕咬」「合唱齐射」「合唱压境」「深海触腕」。拆除合唱海嗣可削弱齐射与压境，击破歌眼可中断泪滴共鸣并解除对应精英强化。
en: Final Boss of Ending 3 'Price of Peace'. Humanoid phase cannot be attacked; heals Seaborn and enhances them into Elites, marking enhanced targets with a red outline. Three teardrops each sustain one Elite; touching a teardrop permanently purifies it and removes the corresponding enhancement. Unpurified tears accelerate transformation, becoming destructible Song Eyes after transforming. Hostile form has seven active attacks: 'Falling Tears', 'Triple-Line Sweep', 'Song of We Many', 'Bite', 'Chorus Volley', 'Encroaching Chorus', and 'Abyssal Tentacle'. Eliminating chorus Seaborn weakens Chorus Volley and Encroaching Chorus. Destroying Song Eyes interrupts Teardrop Resonance and removes the corresponding Elite enhancement.

keys: 结局二「静谧时代」的最终 Boss。八种主动攻击：「冲锋」「冰线」「长枪连刺」「掷枪」「长枪回旋」「踏冰裂阵」「断潮劈击」「侧踏挑枪」。冰线后接寒冷追击，裂阵封锁三条通道，劈击向前推进，侧踏后重新瞄准挑枪。一阶段布置五根冰柱，全部撞碎后才生成下一批。首次生命归零后寒冰重生，残柱碎裂且不再生成，冲锋接续三段；累积受击可触发寒冷反击。
en: Final Boss of Ending 2 'Age of the Silence'. Eight active attacks: 'Charge', 'Frost Line', 'Lance Combo', 'Throw Spear', 'Lance Spin', 'Ice-Shattering Stomp', 'Tide-Severing Cleave', and 'Side-Step Upward Thrust'. Frost Line is followed by Cold Pursuit. Ice-Shattering Stomp blocks three paths. Tide-Severing Cleave advances forward. Side-steps before re-aiming for Upward Thrust. Phase 1 deploys five ice pillars; the next batch spawns only after all are shattered by ramming. Revives from ice when HP reaches zero for the first time; remaining pillars shatter and no longer spawn, Charge extends to three segments. Taking cumulative hits triggers a Cold counterattack.
